# jumpcloud_scheduled_report (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud scheduled report by ID or display name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by display name
data "jumpcloud_scheduled_report" "compliance" {
  display_name = "Weekly Compliance Report"
}

# Look up by ID
data "jumpcloud_scheduled_report" "by_id" {
  id = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the scheduled report. Exactly one of id or display_name must be specified.
- `id` (String) The ID of the scheduled report. Exactly one of id or display_name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `days` (List of String) Days to run the report.
- `description` (String) Description of the scheduled report.
- `export_type` (String) Export format: csv or json.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the scheduled report is active.
- `recipients` (String) JSON-encoded list of notification recipients.
- `report_id` (String) The ID of the report view or template.
- `report_type` (String) Type of report: report_view or report_template.
- `schedule_frequency` (String) How often the report runs: daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly.
- `schedule_time` (String) Time of day to run the report.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone for the schedule.
